name: Soyuz-19
about: Soyuz-19 (1975-065A), a crewed vehicle (7K-TM), launched 1975 Jul 15. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1975 Jul 17), held fixed
